news.headline: NKTR Stock Soars After Nektar Reports Positive Atopic Dermatitis Trial Results
Nektar Shares Fall Nearly 10% as Jury Weighs Low-Damages Scenario in Eli Lilly Trial
news.summary: Nektar shares fell as much as 9.6-11% to around $60.43 on September 22 after courtroom observers reported the deliberating federal jury had asked questions about scenarios involving low or no damages in Nektar's roughly $1 billion breach-of-contract case against Eli Lilly over rezpegaldesleukin. As of September 23 the jury had not yet returned a verdict.

news.headline: Lilly Left Nektar Drug 'Damaged Goods,' Jury Told At Trial End
news.summary: In closing arguments in the roughly $1 billion breach-of-contract trial, Nektar's counsel told a California federal jury that Eli Lilly turned rezpegaldesleukin into 'damaged goods' by breaching the companies' co-development deal and delaying the drug in favor of a competing Lilly asset it later acquired. The jury began deliberating after closing arguments and, as of September 22, 2026, has not yet returned a verdict.

news.headline: Lilly Owes Nektar $1B If It Breached Rezpeg Deal, Jury Told
news.summary: Nektar's damages expert testified that Eli Lilly could owe the company nearly $1 billion if the jury finds it breached the 2017 license agreement to co-develop rezpegaldesleukin, laying out Nektar's financial theory of harm from Lilly's handling of the drug's early atopic dermatitis and lupus trials.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Enters Quiet Period Ahead of REZOLVE-AA Durability Data
news.summary: Nektar disclosed it entered a quiet period beginning September 8, 2026 that will continue until it publicly announces data from the 24-week off-treatment follow-up period of its Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA alopecia areata study, consistent with its practice ahead of prior REZOLVE readouts. As of September 22, 2026 the company remains in this quiet period and the durability data have not yet been released.

news.headline: Eli Lilly 'Sabotaged' Rezpeg's Development, Nektar Tells Jury
news.summary: In opening statements of the federal trial, Nektar's lawyer told the jury that Eli Lilly breached the companies' co-development deal and 'sabotaged' rezpegaldesleukin's development to favor a competing drug, while Lilly's counsel countered that Nektar was not harmed by the 2023 termination; the dispute centers on differing analyses of early trial data (Lilly's 17% vs. Nektar's 36% placebo-adjusted improvement).

news.headline: Nektar Announces Publication in The Lancet of Positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD 16-Week Induction Results
news.summary: Nektar announced peer-reviewed publication in The Lancet of full efficacy, safety, pharmacodynamic and biomarker findings from the 16-week induction period of the 393-patient Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD study, which met all primary and key secondary endpoints in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis. The publication bolsters the scientific case underpinning the newly launched Phase 3 ZENITH AD program.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Nektar reported Q2 2026 revenue of $10.1 million and a narrowed net loss of $40.6 million, with cash and investments of $1.02 billion as of June 30, 2026, bolstered by a $350 million public offering. The company highlighted the July 2026 start of its Phase 3 ZENITH AD program for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis and finalized design of a registrational Phase 3 alopecia areata study.

catalysts.label: Jury verdict in Nektar v. Eli Lilly trial
catalysts.detail: A California federal jury is deliberating on Nektar's roughly $1 billion breach-of-contract claim alleging Lilly mishandled and 'sabotaged' rezpegaldesleukin's co-development under their 2017 deal; as of September 23, 2026 no verdict has been returned. Courtroom observers reported the jury asked questions on September 22 about scenarios involving low or no damages, which knocked NKTR shares down roughly 10% that day. A verdict for Nektar could materially bolster its cash position, while a defense verdict would remove the litigation upside but end the overhang.

catalysts.label: REZOLVE-AA 24-week off-treatment durability data
catalysts.detail: Nektar has been in a self-imposed quiet period since September 8, 2026 ahead of releasing 24-week off-treatment follow-up data from the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA alopecia areata study, a key durability readout for rezpegaldesleukin; the data had not yet been announced as of September 22, 2026.

catalysts.label: Start of registrational Phase 3 alopecia areata study
catalysts.detail: Nektar plans to begin a single registrational Phase 3 trial of rezpegaldesleukin in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata, with design finalized following FDA End-of-Phase 2 feedback and EMA scientific advice.

catalysts.label: Initiation of ZENITH AD-3 (treatment-experienced) Phase 3 trial
catalysts.detail: The third and final trial of the global registrational ZENITH AD program, enrolling roughly 510 atopic dermatitis patients with prior biologic and/or JAK inhibitor treatment experience, is guided to begin in September 2026, completing initiation of the ~1,530-patient three-trial program alongside ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2 (both started July 2026).

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline data
catalysts.detail: Initial topline results are expected from the global registrational ZENITH AD-1/AD-2/AD-3 program (about 1,530 patients) evaluating rezpegaldesleukin in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, with a BLA submission targeted for 2029.

catalysts.label: Third-quarter 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Nektar's next scheduled quarterly earnings report, which should provide updated commentary on cash runway (guided into Q3 2028), the outcome of the Lilly litigation, and REZOLVE-AA durability data if not yet released.

pulse: Nektar remains suspended between two binary, near-term events: a California federal jury has been deliberating since September 18, 2026 on Nektar's roughly $1 billion breach-of-contract claim against Eli Lilly over the botched rezpeg co-development deal, with no verdict yet as of September 23, and the company has been in a quiet period since September 8 ahead of Q4 2026 REZOLVE-AA alopecia areata durability data. Sentiment turned jittery on September 22 after courtroom observers said the jury had asked about low-or-no-damages scenarios, sending shares down roughly 10% to around $60. Meanwhile the atopic dermatitis franchise keeps advancing on schedule, with an August 25 Lancet publication reinforcing the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD data and the third leg of the Phase 3 ZENITH AD program (ZENITH AD-3) guided to start this month alongside the already-dosing AD-1 and AD-2 trials. Q2 2026 results showed a narrowing net loss and cash/investments over $1 billion (runway into Q3 2028), and the stock, now roughly +45-50% year-to-date after the Sept 22 pullback, remains highly sensitive to both the Lilly verdict and the pending alopecia durability readout.
